question: Dolly goes to a shop to purchase a toy bus priced at ₹5,300. She is offered 4 discount options by the shopkeeper. Which of the following options should she opt for to gain maximum advantage of the discount offered?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Compare effective discounts

A: 7 + 7 − (7×7/100) = 14 − 0.49 = 13.51%

B: 43 + 38 − (43×38/100) = 81 − 16.34 = 64.66%

C: 21 + 21 − (21×21/100) = 42 − 4.41 = 37.59%

D: 47%

**∴ Maximum discount = Option 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

MP = ₹5300

**Formula used:**

Successive discount = a + b − (ab/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Option 1 = 13.51%

⇒ Option 2 = 64.66%

⇒ Option 3 = 37.59%

⇒ Option 4 = 47%

⇒ Highest discount = 64.66%

**∴ The correct answer is Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Net = a + b − (ab/100)

Comparison Trick

Convert all offers into single % and compare
